name: W Ibiza
positioning: A seasonal beachfront W hotel in Santa Eulalia on Ibiza's east coast, with a beach-access pool deck, a rooftop infinity pool and bohemian, color-splashed rooms
best_for: Friends and couples who want beach days and a rooftop pool scene on Ibiza's east coast
Travelers who want a room with a balcony or a private pool by the sea

facts.text: The hotel is on Ibiza's east coast.
Most rooms have a walk-on balcony.
The duplex Penthouse Suite is on the top floor with a very large balcony and sea views.
Rooms have a Mixbar in-room cocktail service with designer martini glasses.
AWAY Spa offers more than 15 treatments, including skincare, manicures and pedicures.
The FIT gym is open 24/7 with Technogym equipment and graffiti-covered walls.
Yellow Fish Restaurant serves grilled local fish, Spanish tapas and sangria overlooking Santa Eulalia's shore.
Santa Eulalia has a beachfront promenade that is good for bar-hopping at night.
Ibiza Airport is about 22 km from the hotel.

highlights.text: WET Deck has a pool, a bar with light bites and sun loungers, with direct access to the beach.
GLOW is a rooftop with an infinity pool looking out across Santa Eulalia Bay.
W Ibiza is on the palm-fringed beachfront of Santa Eulalia.
Rooms mix splatter paints and colorful fabrics inspired by hippie summers.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the high-energy party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
